title: RflySim / Real4Real
paragraphs: Preparation and blockers · 8 October 2026
Candidate: dynamics/control host and native visual baseline
A, B and coupled capture pending · C blocked
notes: Preparation only. No simulator execution, rented hardware or fabricated measurements. See docs/rflysim/handoff.md.

title: Real4Real inputs and target
paragraphs: Real images + calibrated poses → reconstruction → scene representation → new trajectories → observations → downstream evaluation
Residential, suburban and campus environments below 100 m; horizontal and vertical camera motion
Missing: imagery, calibration, reconstruction, split, held-out views, downstream model and approved fidelity thresholds
notes: docs/r4r-audit-context.md; user 2026-10-08 prompt. Stock RGB does not establish reconstruction fidelity or transfer.

title: Component ownership
paragraphs: Python setpoints → PX4 SITL → actuator commands → CopterSim dynamics and simulated sensors → PX4 estimates
CopterSim truth → UE4 RflySim3D → mounted camera observations; UE supplies scene collisions and visual depth
MATLAB/Simulink authors models. Standalone installer may run the precompiled stock model without model compilation

title: Release and host gate
paragraphs: Official page names RflySimToolchain-v5.01-20260831.iso. Download link requires contact details; ISO URL, bytes, hash and EULA are missing
CopterSim lists Linux support. A complete licensed Free Linux visual and camera release has not been established
Candidate supported path: Windows native graphics + Python + CopterSim; PX4 in default WSL1 RflySim-20.04. Desktop, privilege and reboot access unverified

title: Resources and access
paragraphs: Provisional RTX A5000 ×1, 24 GB: expected sufficiency for one drone and one RGB camera is an estimate
Planning targets: recent 8-core CPU, 32 GB RAM, 500 GB disk / 300 GB free. Actual allocation, driver, OS and total price unknown
Supplied SSH candidate parsed; key already protected. No connection made. SSH access does not establish a GPU-backed Windows desktop
notes: User 2026-10-08 prompt; official FAQ80–100GB expanded guidance. No A6000 requirement or cheapest-host claim. Address stays in ignored local access-candidate.json.

title: Frozen B route and criteria
paragraphs: Position error ≤0.25 m for a continuous 2 s dwell at every leg. Target setpoint rate 10 Hz; 75 s flight and separate 15 s cleanup watchdog
Minimum integration: takeoff, two waypoint transitions, landing/disarming. Full completion: every prescribed leg meets tolerance/dwell and confirms landing/disarming
notes: simulators/rflysim/audit-config.json. User-preserved acceptance criteria; audit-specific takeoff/touchdown criteria in handoff. B not tested.

title: A camera calibration and replay
paragraphs: Seven desired camera poses: baseline at (0,0,−2); +1 m north; +1 m east; 1 m higher; yaw +15°; pitch +10°; baseline again
640×480 RGB, requested 10 Hz, 21 s sequence replayed twice; 5 s warmup. Short rate test: 30 s after 5 s warmup
Repeatability: 0.02 m and 1°. Known-geometry reprojection: 2% of image dimension. Clearance, geometry, actual pose and clock mapping still block execution freeze
notes: simulators/rflysim/audit-config.json. Camera modes/world conventions require installed validation; numerical choices are audit settings, not lab thresholds.

title: Flight-to-observation evidence
paragraphs: Commands → PX4 → dynamics → achieved simulator state → actual camera pose → timestamped RGB
B initial run without capture; reset and repeat the same route once with mounted capture if supported. Keep image/GPU/file workers separate from control
Record source clocks and receiver clocks, pose brackets, offsets, uncertainty, stale frames, gaps and missed deadlines. Reference poses and PX4 estimates cannot become camera truth
notes: docs/rflysim/interfaces.md; pinned VisionCaptureApi.py lines1340–1455; UE4CtrlAPI reqCam/getCamCoptObj documentation. Coupled capture blocked pending actual pose/time verification.

title: Runner findings
paragraphs: Recovered runner preserves evidence but cannot enforce deadlines independently of blocking SDK calls
PNG saving and GPU queries share the control loop; cached frames may be stale. No waypoint dwell or confirmed touchdown/disarm pass is implemented
Current entry point validates preparation and verifies hashes; simulator execution is disabled. Installed adapter, watchdog and capture isolation remain pending
notes: docs/rflysim/runner-review.md; recovered script exact hash in recovery.json. Public camera source lacks stopRun definition. No experiments were run.

title: Capture import and fidelity
paragraphs: Direct real images + poses: no inspected reconstruction loader established
Mesh route is documented through UE import, baking/cooking and XML MeshPath indexing. It is not a generic runtime OBJ/PLY loader; Free eligibility remains unresolved
Gaussian loader: no supported path established. Sparse capture coverage, altitude extrapolation and held-out fidelity remain blocked by missing calibrated assets
notes: https://rflysim.com/doc/en/4.DevRef/3d-import.html ; docs/rflysim/interfaces.md. No PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS or stock-image fidelity claims.

title: Gaussian renderer boundary
paragraphs: Pose replay exports a route. Native visual replacement changes the renderer. Closed-loop visual control also requires a compatible observation/action consumer
A separate renderer using CopterSim truth and calibrated extrinsics is inferred feasible; native image injection, reset/step and clock ownership are unresolved
UE collision and depth services must be retained or replaced with independently validated geometry. Implementation is outside preparation
notes: docs/rflysim/interfaces.md. Public VisionCaptureApi is receive/forward code, not a Gaussian integration demonstration.

title: Policy and task status
paragraphs: PX4 plus scripted waypoints is a controller, not a released autonomy policy
RflyArena publishes state-feedback RL weights: 25-dimensional state/error/reference input and throttle/body-rate output. Default-model and task compatibility are not established
No compatible R4R visual policy, scene/task or adapter supplied. C remains blocked; no unrelated weights or training
notes: https://github.com/RflySim/RflyArena/blob/c43421ed5ccc46d4d049d94ac3af8ebbe8b80137/src/rl_control/scripts/control_rl_node.py#L485 ; source tree asset sizes in docs/rflysim/assets.md.

title: Applicability and decision
paragraphs: Indoor: candidate control/sensor integration. Outdoor residential/campus: candidate mesh baseline; reconstruction and novel-view accuracy unresolved
Sparse physical content and sparse captures need different tests. Racing needs gate perception, high-speed dynamics and collision timing evidence
Defer renderer adoption. Retain RflySim as a candidate dynamics/control host and native visual baseline, subject to host/release/SDK gates
notes: docs/rflysim/handoff.md; docs/r4r-audit-context.md. All task outcomes not tested; no real-world transfer claim.

title: Learning and preservation
paragraphs: Read SITLRun.bat, PX4MavCtrlV4.py, VisionCaptureApi.py, UE4CtrlAPI.py, model/scene XML and PX4 parameters: trace process ownership, NED/FRD, units, timestamps and modes
One writer on audit/rflysim; small evidence/deck in Git, bulk artifacts retained separately. Bundle relay can replace remote GitHub authentication
2 h active setup/debug and at most 2 repairs. Test transfer first; checkpoint during work/failure, finalize hashes and verify local media. Never terminate the instance automatically
notes: docs/rflysim/setup.md and handoff.md; preservation verification recorded in result directory. Preparation deck is not measured results.
